doc: The South Carolina counties a contact can be recorded in.
The race/ethnicity codes, in the order the source list carries them rather than alphabetically.
The order is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: this is a merged legacy code list carrying genuine
duplicates - A and AP both read ASIAN OR PACIFIC ISLANDER, as do I/AI, B/BK and O/AO - and a lookup by
description stops on the first match. Re-sorting it would change which code a dropped name resolves to.
